title: Participation capacity instrument for emerging farmer programmes: public materials from a doctoral thesis on the Eastern Cape ostrich supply chain
description:
Public materials from Timothy Pittaway's Doctor Technologiae thesis (Nelson Mandela Metropolitan University, 2013) on how emerging farmers in the Eastern Cape, South Africa, can participate in the ostrich industry's export supply chain.

Includes the participation capacity instrument (Local Vulnerability, Human Capacity, Agrarian Capacity and Market Access indices) with scoring rules and a blank scoring template, the research design, questionnaire structure, and the twelve recommended interventions. No participant data is included.
